title: Workspace specification
description: The rephraser's output and the suggestor's input: a typed envelope with a natural-language purpose per slot, or the typed not-a-workspace verdict. The envelope is machine-checkable; the purpose stays in words, because that is where 'close to their query' lives and the catalogue's own vocabulary is too product-shaped to express intent. It carries NO SKU, NO PRICE, NO PRODUCT NAME and NO band label.

status.description: notWorkspace ends the run as a result, not an error.

reason.description: A one-line reason, present when status is notWorkspace.

ceilingMonthly.description: Carried through from the request when the customer named one; never invented.

slots.description: The slots the customer cares about, each with how many and what for.

constraints.description: Free-text constraints from the sentence - 'small room', 'must be quiet'.

slot.description: The slot this specification is for. Kept in step with the request schema by a test, so every file stays self-contained.

purpose.description: Ordinary words - 'a large, stable surface for two monitors'. Not a SKU and not a catalogue tag.
